channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: IRGC claims ‘retaliatory attack’ on Kuwait
item.description: Iran has continued its attacks on Gulf states, in what it calls retaliation for US strikes on Thursday.

item.title: Iran holds funeral for Revolutionary Guard members reportedly killed in US
item.description: Residents gathered in the northwestern Iranian for the funeral of IRGC members killed in what Iran says was a US strike.

item.title: Southern Lebanese towns near Beaufort Castle hit by Israeli strikes
item.description: IDF said it used 700 tonnes of explosives to destroy parts of a Hezbollah tunnel network in southern Lebanon.

item.title: Death toll from Japan earthquake climbs to 34
item.description: The magnitude 7.1 quake has killed 34 people and left six more seriously injured.

item.title: Nepal’s PM urges calm as three people killed after Hindu-Muslim unrest
item.description: Three dead in violence in Nepal, as authorities enforce curfews and pledge to restore 'peace and unity'.

item.title: Hamas says it has agreed to disarm after Trump announces Board of Peace plan
item.description: A senior Hamas official has told the BBC they have agreed to the Board of Peace's plan. Israel has not commented.

item.title: At least five members of same family killed in Russian missile attack, Zelensky says
item.description: A six-year-old girl and two boys, aged 11 and 17, were among six killed in a village near the central city of Kryvyi Rih.

item.title: Why limited war with the US may suit Iran better than peace
item.description: Iran may believe it can control its conflict carefully enough to keep pressure on the US while avoiding an all-out war.

item.title: Danube's record low levels force shutdown of Hungary's only nuclear plant
item.description: Romania, Bulgaria and Serbia are also grappling with the effects of a series of prolonged heatwaves and low rainfall.

item.title: Cyanide in tomato pesticide killed 15 elephants, Kenyan officials suspect
item.description: Foul play is ruled out in the record number of elephant deaths for decades in this area of southern Kenya.
